verdict.rationale: Viam has no built-in natural-language command interface. It does document a path for external AI agents to operate machines via shell or SDK (viam-docs-12, viam-docs-31, viam-docs-32), backed by a CLI that calls any machine API with JSON in and out (viam-docs-30) and a published llms.txt (viam-probe-1). Natural-language operation is therefore possible, but only by bringing your own agent to translate commands into CLI or SDK calls. Missing for 10: a native natural-language or chat interface in the app or CLI, an official MCP server or agent integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.
